name: MailMerge
description: Represents the mail merge functionality in Word.
remarks: Use the MailMerge property to return the MailMerge object. The MailMerge object is always available regardless of whether the mail merge operation has begun. Use the State property to determine the status of the mail merge operation. The following example executes a mail merge if the active document is a main document with an attached data source. The following example merges the main document with the first three records in the attached data source and then sends the results to the printer.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified MailMerge object.

properties.name: MainDocumentType
properties.description: Returns or sets the mail merge main document type. Read/write WdMailMergeMainDocType.

properties.name: State
properties.description: Returns the current state of a mail merge operation. Read-only WdMailMergeState.

properties.name: Destination
properties.description: Returns or sets the destination of the mail merge results. Read/write WdMailMergeDestination.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.description: Returns a MailMergeDataSource object that refers to the data source attached to a mail merge main document. Read-only.

properties.name: Fields
properties.description: Returns a read-only MailMergeFields collection that represents all the mail merge fields in the specified document.

properties.name: ViewMailMergeFieldCodes
properties.description: True if merge field names are displayed in a mail merge main document. False if information from the current record is displayed. Read/write Long.

properties.name: SuppressBlankLines
properties.description: True if blank lines are suppressed when mail merge fields in a mail merge main document are empty. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MailAsAttachment
properties.description: True if the merge documents are sent as attachments when the mail merge destination is an email message or a fax. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MailAddressFieldName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the field that contains email addresses that are used when the mail merge destination is electronic mail. Read/write String.

properties.name: MailSubject
properties.description: Returns or sets the subject line used when the mail merge destination is electronic mail. Read/write String.

properties.name: HighlightMergeFields
properties.description: True to highlight the merge fields in a document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MailFormat
properties.description: Returns a WdMailMergeMailFormat constant that represents the format to use when the mail merge destination is an email message. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowSendToCustom
properties.description: Returns or sets a String corresponding to the caption on a custom button on the Complete the merge step (step six) of the Mail Merge Wizard. Read/write.

properties.name: WizardState
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long indicating the current Mail Merge Wizard step for a document. The WizardState method returns a number that equates to the current Mail Merge Wizard step; a zero (0) means the Mail Merge Wizard is closed. Read/write.

methods.name: CreateDataSource
methods.signature: CreateDataSource([Name As Variant], [PasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [HeaderRecord As Variant], [MSQuery As Variant], [SQLStatement As Variant], [SQLStatement1 As Variant], [Connection As Variant], [LinkToSource As Variant])
methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Word document that uses a table to store data for a mail merge.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The path and file name for the new data source.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to open the new data source.

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the data source.

parameters.name: HeaderRecord
parameters.description: Field names for the header record. If this argument is omitted, the standard header record is used: "Title, FirstName, LastName, JobTitle, Company, Address1, Address2, City, State, PostalCode, Country, HomePhone, WorkPhone." To separate field names, use the list separator specified in Regional Settings in Control Panel.

parameters.name: MSQuery
parameters.description: True to launch Microsoft Query, if it is installed. The Name, PasswordDocument, and HeaderRecord arguments are ignored.

parameters.name: SQLStatement
parameters.description: Defines query options for retrieving data.

parameters.name: SQLStatement1
parameters.description: If the query string is longer than 255 characters, SQLStatement specifies the first portion of the string, and SQLStatement1 specifies the second portion.

parameters.name: Connection
parameters.description: A range within which the query specified by SQLStatement will be performed.

parameters.name: LinkToSource
parameters.description: True to perform the query specified by Connection and SQLStatement each time the main document is opened.

methods.name: CreateHeaderSource
methods.signature: CreateHeaderSource(Name As String, [PasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [HeaderRecord As Variant])
methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Word document that stores a header record that is used instead of the data source header record in a mail merge.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The path and file name for the new header source.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to open the new header source.

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the new header source.

parameters.name: HeaderRecord
parameters.description: A string that specifies the field names for the header record. If this argument is omitted, the standard header record is used: "Title, FirstName, LastName, JobTitle, Company, Address1, Address2, City, State, PostalCode, Country, HomePhone, WorkPhone." To separate field names in Microsoft Windows, use the list separator specified in Regional Settings in Control Panel.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the specified mail merge operation.

parameters.name: Pause
parameters.description: True for Microsoft Word pause and display a troubleshooting dialog box if a mail merge error is found. False to report errors in a new document.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Simulates the mail merge operation, pausing to report each error as it occurs.

methods.name: EditDataSource
methods.description: Opens or switches to the mail merge data source.

methods.name: EditHeaderSource
methods.description: Opens the header source attached to a mail merge main document, or activates the header source if it is already open.

methods.name: EditMainDocument
methods.description: Activates the mail merge main document associated with the specified header source or data source document.

methods.name: OpenDataSource
methods.signature: OpenDataSource(Name As String, [Format As Variant], [ConfirmConversions As Variant], [ReadOnly As Variant], [LinkToSource As Variant], [AddToRecentFiles As Variant], [PasswordDocument As Variant], [PasswordTemplate As Variant], [Revert As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordTemplate As Variant], [Connection As Variant], [SQLStatement As Variant], [SQLStatement1 As Variant], [OpenExclusive As Variant], [SubType As Variant])
methods.description: Attaches a data source to the specified document, which becomes a main document if it is not one already.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The data source file name. You can specify a Microsoft Query (.qry) file instead of specifying a data source, a connection string, and a query string.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The file converter used to open the document. Can be one of the WdOpenFormat constants. To specify an external file format, use the OpenFormat property with the FileConverter object to determine the value to use with this argument.

parameters.name: ConfirmConversions
parameters.description: True to display the Convert File dialog box if the file is not in Microsoft Word format.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: True to open the data source on a read-only basis.

parameters.name: LinkToSource
parameters.description: True to perform the query specified by Connection and SQLStatement each time the main document is opened.

parameters.name: AddToRecentFiles
parameters.description: True to add the file name to the list of recently used files at the bottom of the File menu.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password used to open the data source. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: PasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password used to open the template. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: Revert
parameters.description: Controls what happens if Name is the file name of an open document. True to discard any unsaved changes to the open document and reopen the file; False to activate the open document.

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password used to save changes to the document. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: WritePasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password used to save changes to the template. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: Connection
parameters.description: A range within which the query specified by SQLStatement is to be performed. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: SQLStatement
parameters.description: Defines query options for retrieving data. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: SQLStatement1
parameters.description: If the query string is longer than 255 characters, SQLStatement specifies the first portion of the string, and SQLStatement1 specifies the second portion. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: OpenExclusive
parameters.description: True to open exclusively.

parameters.name: SubType
parameters.description: Can be one of the WdMergeSubType constants.

methods.name: OpenHeaderSource
methods.signature: OpenHeaderSource(Name As String, [Format As Variant], [ConfirmConversions As Variant], [ReadOnly As Variant], [AddToRecentFiles As Variant], [PasswordDocument As Variant], [PasswordTemplate As Variant], [Revert As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordTemplate As Variant], [OpenExclusive As Variant])
methods.description: Attaches a mail merge header source to the specified document.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The file name of the header source.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The file converter used to open the document. Can be one of the WdOpenFormat constants. To specify an external file format, use the OpenFormat property with a FileConverter object to determine the value to use with this argument.

parameters.name: ConfirmConversions
parameters.description: True to display the Convert File dialog box if the file isn't in Microsoft Word format.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: True to open the header source on a read-only basis.

parameters.name: AddToRecentFiles
parameters.description: True to add the file name to the list of recently used files at the bottom of the File menu.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to open the header source document. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: PasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password required to open the header source template. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: Revert
parameters.description: Controls what happens if Name is the file name of an open document. True to discard any unsaved changes to the open document and reopen the file; False to activate the open document.

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the document data source. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: WritePasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the template data source. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: OpenExclusive
parameters.description: True to open exclusively.

methods.name: ShowWizard
methods.signature: ShowWizard(InitialState As Variant, [ShowDocumentStep As Variant], [ShowTemplateStep As Variant], [ShowDataStep As Variant], [ShowWriteStep As Variant], [ShowPreviewStep As Variant], [ShowMergeStep As Variant])
methods.description: Displays the Mail Merge Wizard in a document.

parameters.name: InitialState
parameters.description: The number of the Mail Merge Wizard step to display.

parameters.name: ShowDocumentStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Select document type" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step one.

parameters.name: ShowTemplateStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Select starting document" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step two.

parameters.name: ShowDataStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Select recipients" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step three.

parameters.name: ShowWriteStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Write your letter" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step four.

parameters.name: ShowPreviewStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Preview your letters" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step five.

parameters.name: ShowMergeStep
parameters.description: True keeps the "Complete the merge" step in the sequence of mail merge steps. False removes step six.
